basis: 95th percentiles of 24 samples per operation across the eight fleet repositories (evidence/performance-baseline.json), with headroom for slower CI runners. Interactive answers stay under one second and a cold command under two and a half seconds.

startupMs.description: A cold CLI process: load the registry, analyze the project, and answer one context query

packageSnapshotLoadMs.description: Load and verify the embedded registry snapshot

readerMs.description: Scan the working tree through the conforming reader

bundleMs.description: Run the pinned repo-facts bundle over the reader

indexMs.description: Build the Web Doctor extension index

incrementalQueryMs.description: Observe one source edit and answer a query from the new project state

eslintMs.description: Run diagnostics with the ESLint provider and a twenty-rule enterprise baseline

reactDoctorMs.description: Run diagnostics with the approved React Doctor provider

mcpResponseMs.description: Answer a warm MCP context or guidance request

serviceLevels.application: About 2,000 source files, a typical enterprise React application
serviceLevels.verification: Measured on pilot applications before any Control gates CI
